LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS/CROSS COMPLAINANTS RICHARD PETERS, MADELINE PETERS, MITCHELL PETERS, LINDA PETERS, DANIEL PETERS, ELIZABETH PETERS, JOHN MONTGOMERY AND WEST GROUP REAL ESTATE, INCORPORATED'S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE CROSS-COMPLAINT IS DENIED. IN LIGHT OF THE CURRENT TRIAL DATE, THERE WOULD BE OBVIOUS PREJUDICE IN PERMITTING DEFENDANTS TO BRING IN NEW PARTIES AND NON-COMPULSORY CLAIMS AGAINST PLAINTIFF. ALL OF THE CLAIMS HAVE TO DO IN SIGNIFICANT PART WITH CLAIMS THAT THE CURRENT CASE IS A MALICIOUS PROSECUTION THOUGH IT HAS NOT YET BEEN ADJUDICATED. MOREOVER, THE ATTEMPT TO SUE PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY AT THIS APPEAR TO BE A BAD FAITH TACTIC. ALTHOUGH THERE MAY BE A COMPULSORY CLAIM AGAINST PLAINTIFF BURRIED IN DEFENDANT'S PROPOSED CROSS-COMPLAINT, IT IS INTERMINGLED WITH THE OTHER CLAIMS, AND IT WOULD BE INAPPROPRIATE TO PERMIT THE PROPOSED PLEADING TO BE FILED ESPECIALLY ON THE EVE OF TRIAL. THIS IS WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO A PROPER REQUEST FOR A COMPULSORY CROSS-CLAIM. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER, CAROL A. KAREN, CSR #8189
